key_claims: Fluctuations in estrogen influence the brain, helping reshape connections between neurons.
Magnetic resonance elastography (MRE) can detect estrogen-dependent mechanical changes in the hippocampus.
These changes occur across the reproductive cycle.
limitations: The source does not specify the number of participants or the study design details.
The source does not provide information on the magnitude or clinical significance of the changes.
The source does not mention any potential confounding factors or limitations of the MRE technique.
what_not_to_say: The study proves that estrogen causes brain changes.
The study shows that MRE can diagnose or treat any condition.
The study provides evidence for the effectiveness of any intervention.
